caption: The drawing depicts a round plate with a decorative floral design in its center. The plate is predominantly colored in earthy tones, including shades of brown, yellow, and green. The central motif is a stylized flower with a large bloom, featuring pointed petals with green interiors and brownish accents, situated on a stem that extends vertically. Surrounding the flower are multiple leafy branches, arranged symmetrically and curving along the inner edge of the plate. The leaves are elongated, with each branch displaying several leaves branching from the main stem. The background within the plate shows a blend of green and yellow hues, interspersed with some brown shading, providing a textured effect. The rim of the plate is outlined in brown. The plate is presented against a plain, beige background. There is a small shadow or base beneath the lower right edge of the plate, and a signature along with a date is visible near the shadow.
title: Pa. German Plate
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
